title: Singapore Noodles
description: A curry-spiced stir-fry of egg noodles, pork loin and prawns with peppers and mangetout, seasoned with Chinese five spice, soy and turmeric.
ingredients: 2 pork loin steaks (~250g total), fat trimmed, finely sliced
3 spring onions, trimmed and finely sliced
½ red pepper, deseeded and finely sliced
1 red chilli, deseeded and finely sliced, to serve
steps: Cook noodles per package instructions; drain; run under cold water; set aside.
Mix sliced pork with Chinese 5 spice powder.
Mix soy sauce, rice wine, curry powder, turmeric and honey together to make the sauce.
Set wok or sauté pan over high heat; fry pork in cooking spray for 2 minutes. Add prawns; stir-fry 30 seconds.
Add garlic, spring onions, red pepper and mangetout; stir-fry 1½ minutes.
Stir in sauce; tip in noodles; toss everything together; stir-fry 1–2 minutes to heat through.
Serve immediately, sprinkled with sliced red chilli.
notes: Use rice vermicelli noodles if available. Great way to use up leftover veg — julienned carrot, broccoli, baby corn, courgette or sugarsnaps.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
